 Advertising Noah Kahan is bringing The Last Of The Bugs World Tour 2027 to Highmark Stadium
 Oct 29, 2026 at 10:06 AM Buffalo Bills 
 Copied! 
 After a landmark year with his critically acclaimed #1 album and sold-out world tour, 2x GRAMMY®-nominated, multi-platinum artist Noah Kahan  is stepping onto the biggest stages of his career.
 Following this year's sold-out  The Great Divide World Tour , Kahan announces his biggest global headline tour to date: a 31-date stadium run as part of The Last Of The Bugs World Tour . For the first time in his career, after selling out baseball stadiums across the U.S., he'll bring his music to even bigger stadiums across North America, Europe, and the U.K.
 The North American leg of The Last Of The Bugs World Tour , promoted by Live Nation, will make a stop at Highmark Stadium in Buffalo, NY, on June 12, 2027. 
 Following the North American dates, Kahan will head to Europe and the U.K. to continue his stadium run overseas, including stops at Berlin's Waldbühne, Seville's Plaza de España, Paris' Hippodrome ParisLongchamp, and more, as well as three previously announced nights at London's Wembley Stadium. $1.00 per ticket sold goes to The Busyhead Project.
 See the full list of dates for The Last Of The Bugs World Tour below.
 TICKETS (FOR NORTH AMERICA ONLY): To participate in the Noah Kahan Artist Presale on Tuesday, November 10 at 12 pm you must sign up HERE  by Thursday, November 5 at 11:59 pm ET. Artist Presales for this tour are hosted by multiple ticketing sites, but anyone who signs up can join the sale. For Artist Presales on Ticketmaster, no code is needed – access is tied to your account. Artist Presales hosted on other sites may require a code for access. Working in partnership with Ticketmaster, extra protections will be in place to help block bad actors from signing up for the Artist Presale. Some fans may be asked to complete a quick selfie check, or in rare cases, provide an ID via Persona to sign up. Find out more about security checks HERE .
 RESERVED BY SPOTIFY (FOR NORTH AMERICA ONLY): The Reserved by Spotify presale will take place on Wednesday, November 11 at 9 am. Noah Kahan  Reserved by Spotify  tickets may be available to eligible U.S. Spotify Premium subscribers through Ticketmaster. These fans will be notified by Spotify via email and app notification, and will have the opportunity to purchase up to two tickets during the Reserved presale.
 FACE VALUE EXCHANGE (FOR NORTH AMERICA ONLY): Noah Kahan is using Ticketmaster's Face Value Exchange to help fans get tickets at the original price. Tickets purchased on Ticketmaster will be non-transferable and can only be resold on Ticketmaster at face value. In New York where laws prevent resale restrictions, tickets can be transferred, but Ticketmaster will still honor Noah Kahan's terms by keeping resale prices at face value on its site.
 GENERAL ON SALE (ALL DATES): Remaining tickets will be available via the general on sale starting on Thursday, November 12 at 12 pm at NoahKahan.com /pages/tour.
 Next week, Kahan kicks off the sold-out U.K. and European leg of The Great Divide World Tour , following fully sold-out North American, Australian, and New Zealand dates this summer. The Great Divide World Tour  sold more than 1.8 million tickets worldwide and earned Kahan the highest-ranked debut on Pollstar's LIVE75 chart.
 Kahan's The Great Divide  has emerged as a major GRAMMY-season contender, as the record has appeared on every major prediction list for "Album Of The Year," "Record Of The Year," and "Song Of The Year" from Billboard , Rolling Stone , Variety , The Hollywood Reporter , and HITS Daily Double . The recognitions follow his recent cover story in *Billboard*’s 2026 GRAMMY Preview Issue , GRAMMY Museum interview and performance , CBS Sunday Morning interview , and Zane Lowe interview .
 In addition, his critically acclaimed Netflix documentary Noah Kahan: Out of Body  recently entered Letterboxd's Top 50 Documentaries list, following its SXSW 24 Beats Per Second Audience Award win and a perfect 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes.
 Kahan's momentum also continues on the charts, as he remains the only artist to have two albums chart in the Billboard 200 Top 10 for the past six consecutive weeks: the 5x Platinum-certified Stick Season  and Platinum-certified The Great Divide .
 Kahan's new song " Draw You Out " was recently released as the lead single for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album) . Upon release, the track debuted at #1 on Spotify Top Songs Debut USA Chart. The full soundtrack will arrive on November 13, with The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping releasing in theaters on November 20.
